question: How are products linked to orders?
answer: Products are linked to orders through the `OrderItem` model, whose rows each store a `productId` referencing the product's `id`, an `orderId` referencing the order's `id`, and a `quantity` [prisma/schema.prisma:47-54]. `Product` exposes the link from its side as an `items` relation to `OrderItem` [prisma/schema.prisma:27-33]. `Order` carries the matching `items` relation to its `OrderItem` rows [prisma/schema.prisma:36-45]. On a checkout, `placeOrder` looks up the requested products and creates the order with the items nested via `items: { create: input.items }` [src/services/orders.ts:14-21].
